title: Three Afternoons and One Short Chair
subtitle: 休息休闲 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）
meta: 主题语境：休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）　|　核心词汇：leisure　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leisure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the innkeeper ① spent the leisure that no guest in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the spending was the whole of the afternoon. The ② leisure, meaning the ease itself and not the chair, ran three afternoons and stayed unrecorded in the book; leisure, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ hour of leisure in that courtyard had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ leisure at the far tree, meaning the game they kept for the children to play and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Leisure, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the innkeeper said the recording is the part that fills three afternoons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leisure was the whole of the matter, meaning the habit and not the ease. The ⑥ leisure, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leisure, he said, is either something you spend or the only word that means both ease and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ leisure had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ leisure of the whole thing, the innkeeper wrote in June, was one courtyard and three afternoons of recording; leisure, he said, is either the game at the far tree or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leisure I remember is the leisure recorded in the diary, which closed in 1970 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. ⑩ Leisure, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all leisure, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like ease. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 闲暇；空闲（指院子里每一小时旁边的那一小时）
B. n. 闲暇；空闲（指那段闲暇本身，与躺椅相对）
C. 固定搭配：spend the leisure 消磨这段闲暇
D. n. 闲暇；空闲（指留给孩子们玩的那局棋那一段）
E. n. 消遣之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的闲暇之事）
F. n. 闲暇；空闲（指闲记里写到、被记载的的那一段）
G. n. 习惯、自在（指一件事里人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 自在（抽象总称，指人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: spent the leisure that no guest in the courtyard would have recorded
The leisure, meaning the ease itself and not the chair
Every hour of leisure in that courtyard
the leisure at the far tree
the leisure was the whole of the matter
the leisure had become a line in a diary
The leisure of the whole thing

answers.why: spend the leisure 意为“消磨这段闲暇”，1963 年那位店主把院子里没有一位旅客肯记载的一段闲暇做了一遍。
leisure 意为“闲暇；空闲”，指那段闲暇本身而不是躺椅，它经过了三个午后而在簿子上没有被记载。
leisure 意为“闲暇；空闲”，指院子里每一小时旁边的那一小时，每一小时旁边都有同一把矮矮的躺椅。
leisure 意为“闲暇；空闲”，指最远那片树荫留给孩子们玩的那局棋那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leisure 意为“习惯、自在”，指一件事里人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份自在就是那件事的全部。
leisure 意为“自在”，指人人都歇却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段闲暇，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leisure 意为“闲暇；空闲”，指闲记里写到、被记载的的那一段，到 1968 年这一段成了闲记里的一行。
leisure 意为“消遣之事”，店主六月写道，整件事的闲暇之事是一处院子和三个午后的记载。
leisure 意为“闲暇；空闲”，我记得的是闲记里记载过的那一段，1970 年排定了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一段。
leisure 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，闲暇是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的闲暇。
